name: Predis.ai
summary: AI generator for social media posts, ads and short videos, with scheduling.
description: Predis.ai turns text prompts into ads, carousel and video posts for platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube, and includes UGC-style videos and scheduling. The site advertises a three-day free trial; the lowest plan price was not readable, and the highest plan shown was $212 per month billed yearly. It also offers an API and a ChatGPT integration. It positions itself as costing less than $1 per day.
